changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwsurgicalhistory AS SELECT sh.id, sh.patient_id, sh.surgery, sh.date_of_surgery, sh.facility, sh.anesthesia_type, sh.complications, sh.adverse_reactions_to_anesthesia, sh.has_implants_or_devices, sh.implants_or_devices_description, sh.created_by, sh.created_date, sh.last_modified_by, sh.last_modified_date, sh.status, sh.cancelled_by, sh.cancelled_date, sh.cancellation_reason, sh.patient_is_free FROM public.surgical_history sh;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwsurgicalhistory TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwsurgicalhistory FROM report_user;
